question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you think Sara and Nick should be together?
Should Sam and Nick get back together?

labels: Sara and I are still going to win!

nodes.text: He storms out.
Jessica laughs.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Have you `seen` the polls today?
nodes.text_bbcode: Have you [color=#3b78e2][i]seen[/i][/color] the polls today?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just be glad Sara got this far. Because she's not going to win.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And Taylor, Colt, and Amanda still haven't been able to get a lead on Ben.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Don't forget about Justin.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: With voting happening today, Sara doesn't have the slightest chance.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Face it, you're better off just accepting that you've lost.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We'll just see how everyone votes.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And who would do that? You? You've got nothing. No one has!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I might not have any proof, but I know you've done bad things.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I have a feeling I'm not the only person you've victimized to get Ben to the top.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You've probably done stuff to all the other candidates, and it's going to catch up with you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You know what they say about having too many balls in the air...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Eventually, they all `fall.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Eventually, they all [color=#e23b3b][i]fall.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And it's only a matter of time before everyone figures out what you've done!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Because... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yawn.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Because Sara and I are still going to win!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you listening to yourself? Because you sound kinda psycho right now.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So I suppose you're not going to take the pictures down.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nick, if I could, I would consider it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Because I'm warning you... If you don't... You're hurting someone who hasn't done anything to you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sara's done plenty.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I was talking about Sam.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Like I said... It's out of my hands...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now leave. I don't think you have anything else to say that I want to hear.
Nick leaves, but not without one last look at Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You'd better watch your back, Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And why's that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Because...

options.label: Sara and I are still going to win!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Who else benefits from Sara being dragged down?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I have two left feet when it comes to doing anything with computers!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If you're using your feet, I see the problem...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, whatever! I mean, I'd get caught for sure. And then it'd look incredibly bad for Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He could get into some serious trouble!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You think I `want` to get Ben kicked out of the race?
nodes.text_bbcode: You think I [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] to get Ben kicked out of the race?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Huh... That's a good point.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, it is!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But just because you `couldn't` do it... Doesn't mean that you `didn't`... You could still be behind this.
nodes.text_bbcode: But just because you [color=#e23b3b][i]couldn't[/i][/color] do it... Doesn't mean that you [color=#e23b3b][i]didn't[/i][/color]... You could still be behind this.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you even talking about?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sara wasn't even a blip on your radar until she started doing well in the polls.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And then when you saw her star rise during that TV interview with Tucker Garrety...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You realized she was an actual threat.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It made you angry, enraged... You didn't think she deserved it...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And so you acted out.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Isn't it awfully convenient that the minute Sara has the opportunity to dig into Ben's lead, someone posts pictures of me and her in the interview room?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You `wanted` her to fall hard. You probably `enjoyed it.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#e23b3b][i]wanted[/i][/color] her to fall hard. You probably [color=#e23b3b][i]enjoyed it.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `I did!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I did![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: ...Is what I `would` say if I `had` done anything `wrong.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Is what I [color=#3b78e2][i]would[/i][/color] say if I [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] done anything [color=#3b78e2][i]wrong.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: ...You're good.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The best.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You can't point fingers at me. It's no secret I don't like anyone who gets in my way.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But it couldn't have been me. Everyone knows I don't know how to use a computer.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Just because you `don't know how` doesn't mean that you `didn't` do it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Just because you [color=#e23b3b][i]don't know how[/i][/color] doesn't mean that you [color=#e23b3b][i]didn't[/i][/color] do it...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I love Sam. And after the President is announced tomorrow morning, Sara and I have decided not to hang out again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Do you see why I should explain things to Sam?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess you `should` go talk to her... But only once she's had some time to cool off.
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess you [color=#3b78e2][i]should[/i][/color] go talk to her... But only once she's had some time to cool off.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Trust me. Right now she's so angry with you, she wouldn't even be able to understand what you're saying.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But don't worry... She'll probably loosen up enough for you to explain in, like, a week or two!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can't wait that long. She needs to know that I'd never hurt her.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Do you think you can talk to her for me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She'd never believe it coming from me.
Nick's face falls. $ZOE sighs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Listen... Why don't you come around the house sometime after school today?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hopefully by then, she'll have calmed down... At the very least she won't be able to run away...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay. I'll definitely be there.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But I just can't believe someone would do this to her. Who would post these pictures?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And why? What's the point? To hurt Sam? To hurt me?
Nick pauses, thinking.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wait, the person who did this wasn't trying to get back at me or Sam... They were trying to do this to Sara!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You said it yourself. Everyone's talking about this. Well, the picture makes her look like a `terrible` person!
nodes.text_bbcode: You said it yourself. Everyone's talking about this. Well, the picture makes her look like a [color=#e23b3b][i]terrible[/i][/color] person!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No matter what happened at that TV interview, everyone's going to be fixated on this!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Classic political strategy. Tear down the morality of the candidate who's winning.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm going to strangle whatever guy did this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think you mean whatever `girl.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I think you mean whatever [color=#3b78e2][i]girl.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's only one girl I know that's low enough to stoop to this... And that's `Jessica.`
nodes.text_bbcode: There's only one girl I know that's low enough to stoop to this... And that's [color=#3b78e2][i]Jessica.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If you'll excuse me, $ZOE... I have somewhere to be.
Nick strides angrily past her.
He finds Jessica inside a classroom, gossiping with the other cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She was hooking up with her campaign manager? I'm not really surprised.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But, hey, don't let that stop you from voting for the `right` candidate, not the homewrecker.
nodes.text_bbcode: But, hey, don't let that stop you from voting for the [color=#3b78e2][i]right[/i][/color] candidate, not the homewrecker.

nodes.text: Nick approaches her.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Jessica, we need to talk.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Do you think that's a good idea? We're on opposing sides, and it's `voting day.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you think that's a good idea? We're on opposing sides, and it's [color=#3b78e2][i]voting day.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't care. We `will` talk. `Right now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't care. We [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] talk. [color=#e23b3b][i]Right now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Geez, no need to be so demanding...
Jessica glares hard at the other cheerleaders. They scatter.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So... What's going on, Nick? I heard about all that stuff with Sara...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You really shouldn't mix politics and pleasure...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What are you talking about? You're Ben

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's different.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: For one... My candidate is winning... And yours is...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, let's just say people don't like it when their candidates `cheat.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, let's just say people don't like it when their candidates [color=#3b78e2][i]cheat.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: With the votes getting counted today... Who do you think is going to win?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I've been told you're the one who posted the pictures up on the website.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No way! Why would I post those pictures?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fake? Like, someone edited a picture of you and Sara to make it look like you were about to kiss?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Er... Well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's great! This means Sam has nothing to be worried about... It means...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well... Maybe `fake` is a bit of an exaggeration...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... Maybe [color=#e23b3b][i]fake[/i][/color] is a bit of an exaggeration...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you're a `lying,` sleazy, dirty, rotten, cheater.
nodes.text_bbcode: So you're a [color=#3b78e2][i]lying,[/i][/color] sleazy, dirty, rotten, cheater.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, it's not like that!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: This moment did happen, but we definitely did not kiss. In fact, we decided against it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh good.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No listen. Sara might have some feelings for me... But we talked about it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm going to be honest and say that `this` did happen...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm going to be honest and say that [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] did happen...

nodes.text: Nick gestures at the picture.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But Sara and I didn't actually kiss.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You didn't?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No! I mean... It's true that Sara and I have a close connection...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But we talked about it...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't cheat on her! I have no idea what she's talking about...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I've never kissed Sara. I've never done anything with Sara!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm just her campaign manager!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't try to deny it, Nick. I saw the picture with my own eyes!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A picture was posted on The Dirty Dish... It shows you and Sara kissing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everyone's been talking about it all morning!
$ZOE whips her phone out and finds the picture. She turns the screen to show Nick.
The picture shows Nick and Sara right after Andrew's interview, their heads close together, poised to kiss.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sara and I aren't actually kissing in this picture.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But you're clearly about to!

options.label: Sara and I did nothing wrong.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `I know!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I know![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know all about Colt and her past. I know `her,` $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know all about Colt and her past. I know [color=#e23b3b][i]her,[/i][/color] $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then the fact that you cheated on her makes it worse!
Nick doesn't say anything, and $ZOE blithely steamrolls over him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Boy, do I have some words for you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Colt was her first boyfriend and pretty much the love of her life...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then he went and kissed Denni!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It took her a really long time to get over him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So how do you think she feels now that you've made out with Sara?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's hurt all over again! How could you do this to her?!
$ZOE finally takes a breath, and Nick jumps in.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's `wrong` is that I trusted you, and you `cheated on me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What's [color=#3b78e2][i]wrong[/i][/color] is that I trusted you, and you [color=#3b78e2][i]cheated on me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And not with just anyone...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: With `her!`
nodes.text_bbcode: With [color=#3b78e2][i]her![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam points at a Presidential poster of Sara pasted to one of the classroom walls.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Sara. Frikkin'. Kessler!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sara. Frikkin'. Kessler![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I bet you think you're `so` smart, going behind my back, parading around as her 'campaign manager'.
nodes.text_bbcode: I bet you think you're [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] smart, going behind my back, parading around as her 'campaign manager'.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, that's not...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Save it! I'm such an idiot! You know, I thought you were `different`, that you would be the one guy in my life that I could `trust...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Save it! I'm such an idiot! You know, I thought you were [color=#3b78e2][i]different[/i][/color], that you would be the one guy in my life that I could [color=#3b78e2][i]trust...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you're just like every other guy I know!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A sleazy, rotten, dirty cheater!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And we're over!
Sam storms off, and Nick chases after her.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, wait! I don't even understand what you're mad about!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sure I can explain if you just give me the chance...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want to hear it!
Nick steps in front of her.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Please don't run away from me. Let's talk it out...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No!
Sam shoves him back hard!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Stay out of my way! I `never` want to see you `again!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Stay out of my way! I [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] want to see you [color=#3b78e2][i]again![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick tries to follow Sam again, but this time, he's blocked by $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: $ZOE, I...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Aren't you listening? Leave her alone!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't you think you've hurt her enough?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This isn't the first time she's been cheated on, you know...
Nick dodges out of the way, and the hot chocolate sails past him, splattering on the asphalt instead.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You worm!
Sam grabs $ZOE's cup out of her hands and prepares to fling it at him!
Nick raises his hands.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wait! I don't understand...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What... What's wrong?
Sam crushes the cup she's currently holding.
The hot chocolate hits Nick!
It splatters all over his face and his clothes!
Nick sputters, wiping at his hair.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What... What was `that?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What... What was [color=#e23b3b][i]that?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `That` was just the tip of the iceberg!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] was just the tip of the iceberg!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But it will all blow over.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Gossip changes frequently, and soon, people will forget this ever happened.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Now it might not be today, or tomorrow, or even next week... But everything will be fine at some point.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Nothing `feels` fine...
nodes.text_bbcode: Nothing [color=#3b78e2][i]feels[/i][/color] fine...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It will be... You just have to believe it.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'll try.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know you, Sara. You're strong enough to find your way through this.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Eventually, you'll look back on this and only cringe a little.
Sara manages a small smile. Nick smiles back.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I just wish 'eventually' was 'right now'.

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: Nick has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not even some?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Not even a little. I don't like her, and I never will.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Ever.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ever.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good. So what are you going to do about her then?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It would be better if I didn't hang out with her, wouldn't it? I'll talk with her tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good! Now that that's settled...
Sam jumps off the bed and runs to Nick. He wraps his arms around her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick, I missed you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, you know we've only been apart for a few hours, so I doubt you could have generated so much 'missing' that you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shut up and kiss me already.
Nick kisses Sam, and they stay that way for a very long time.
At lunch after the results of the Presidential elections, Nick sits next to Sara in their makeshift cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Nick, how's it going? Did you explain everything to Sam?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I managed to talk to Sam... She forgave me.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That's good to hear! I'm so relieved.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Me too... It looked like she wasn't going to for a moment because of you, but...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What do I have to do with anything?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam wanted to know if I liked you. But don't worry... I told her I didn't, so after that, she and I made up.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh. Yeah. You told her the truth. You don't like me.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: `...Great.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]...Great.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I have some other news... I don't think we should hang out anymore...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, no, you should hang out with people you like, and you don't like me, so...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's not that...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I get it, Nick. We decided we wouldn't hang out after the election anyway, remember? So... Goodbye.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yes... Goodbye.
Nick leaves the table, and his heart suddenly feels leaden in his chest.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If Sam is the girl I want to be with... Why was saying 'goodbye' to Sara so hard?
Over the next couple weeks, Nick begins to wonder if he made the right choice...
At swim practice, he catches himself paying attention to the girl who isn't his girlfriend...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: We won! We won the race!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That means we're going to semifinals!
And sometimes when he's alone with Sam...
Nick wonders if there's someone who he got along better with...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So then I decided to sneak into the empty baseball field with my camera...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick, stop right there. I know how this story ends... You took some awesome pictures that you posted online that people loved.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah... You're right.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And that's great. So moving on, I was thinking we could watch a zombie movie or something...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Another horror movie?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's 'zombie', not 'horror'...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I wasn't aware of the distinction...
Until it all boils over at Sam's house one afternoon...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come here, Nick...
Sam tugs Nick in for a long, slow kiss...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mmmmm...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Mmm...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I like you a lot, Nick...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You too, `Sara...`
nodes.text_bbcode: You too, [color=#e23b3b][i]Sara...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam abruptly pulls away.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What'd you call me?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam! I meant, Sam! Your names both start with 'S'!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I knew it! You've always got her in the back of your mind!
Sam pulls a cup of hot chocolate out of a drawer and hurls it in Nick's face!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Get out of here! I never want to see you again!
Uh-oh! Not telling the truth can really come back to bite you!
Try again and see if some truth-telling will help Nick avoid this volatile situation!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But it doesn't mean anything!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It does to me! I don't want to spend our entire relationship wondering if you're going to leave me for Sara!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Even if Sara and I get along, it doesn't mean I'm just going to ditch you. Who you want to be with is a choice!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And you're mine.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Nick. I can't do it. I can't be with you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe it's a selfish and impossible dream...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But for just `once,` I'd like to be the `only` choice.
nodes.text_bbcode: But for just [color=#3b78e2][i]once,[/i][/color] I'd like to be the [color=#3b78e2][i]only[/i][/color] choice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're `over.`
nodes.text_bbcode: We're [color=#3b78e2][i]over.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam... You... You can't mean that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You should go now.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Get. Out.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Get. Out.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick walks out of the room.
The next day in school...
Nick looks bleakly down at his desk as the morning announcements play on TV.
Erik appears onscreen next to a dour Justin.
On cue, Erik starts singing a jaunty tune.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Morning announcements with Justin and Erik... {

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Your news has never been more generic... {

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Tune in to hear all the fun good stuff... As we regale you with weather, traffic, elections, and fluff! {

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Stop with the `inane` singing...
nodes.text_bbcode: Stop with the [color=#e23b3b][i]inane[/i][/color] singing...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, someone woke up on the mopey side of the bed today! And I bet I know why!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Twin Branches, your votes have been cast, and your voice has been heard!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Your President for the new school year is...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Ben Kale!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ben Kale![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Erik claps his hands, while Justin rolls his eyes.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yes, congratulations to our new `President.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, congratulations to our new [color=#e23b3b][i]President.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hopefully, Ben's tenure will bring a golden period devoid of budget deficit, petty prank wars, and overly indulgent partying.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ditto, Justin! Hear hear! Long live `President Kale!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ditto, Justin! Hear hear! Long live [color=#e23b3b][i]President Kale![/i][/color]

nodes.text: In the classroom...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw man... I lost to Tweed?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Did no one like my bunny campaign?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So much for stopping Jessica...
Meanwhile, Ben cheers!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah! I did it! I won!
Around him, everyone starts clapping. Reluctantly, Nick joins in.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Long live `President Kale!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Long live [color=#3b78e2][i]President Kale![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica stands at Ben's side and shoots everyone a wide smile. When her gaze lands on Nick, she smiles even wider.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Next year, `things are going to change.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Next year, [color=#3b78e2][i]things are going to change.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Well, it sucks for Nick that Ben has won the election... And it's a bummer that Sam decided to break up with Nick...
But somehow, someway, this is the good ending! Be glad that you at least got Nick to talk to Sam!
But what will happen when Ben ascends to the Presidency? Will Jessica ever have to answer for all the terrible things that she's done?
Check in next week to see!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: In fact, I have a great idea!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, Sam's upset because she thinks I cheated on her, right?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So all we have to do is explain to her that the photo didn't mean anything!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I thought that was the plan already...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yes, but it would help out a lot if I could actually `show` Sam that nothing happened between us.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, but it would help out a lot if I could actually [color=#e23b3b][i]show[/i][/color] Sam that nothing happened between us.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: How are we going to do that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We can walk her through what happened that day.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Will that help? She's pretty mad at me...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I honestly don't think she'll want to see us together.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: She will if it exposes the truth. Do you want to make this better or not?
In the auditorium...
Sara and Nick walk through the day of the interview.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, I managed to talk Sam into coming down here... She'll be here any minute.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What are we going to say?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We tell her everything that actually happened.
Nick pulls Sara to a spot just off the stage.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, so we were both talking here after the interview...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You were upset that Andrew had badgered you onstage.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, I was going on about Andrew being a total jerk.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And I was reassuring you, telling you everything was fine.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You're pretty good at doing that...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, you're pretty easy to comfort.
They smile at one another...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Then I started thanking you for everything you've done...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And how much you've meant to me... During the campaign, that is...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I remember saying it was no trouble.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And then I started leaning in like this...
Their eyes lock, and Nick can feel his breath hitch as they stay that way for one long moment...
And then, Nick leans in closer...
Their lips meet just as Sam walks into the auditorium!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `What is going on here?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What is going on here?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sam! You're, uh... We were just... Um...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Making out?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Making out?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam turns to Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This was your big `'surprise',` the one you just `'had to have me see'`?! You kissing Sara `in real life?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This was your big [color=#3b78e2][i]'surprise',[/i][/color] the one you just [color=#3b78e2][i]'had to have me see'[/i][/color]?! You kissing Sara [color=#3b78e2][i]in real life?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I thought the point was to show me that you did `nothing!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I thought the point was to show me that you did [color=#3b78e2][i]nothing![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I can tell you that the kissing part definitely `did` not happen last time!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I can tell you that the kissing part definitely [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] not happen last time!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Oh yeah,` I'm `so` relieved!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oh yeah,[/i][/color] I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] relieved!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can explain...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, no... No way! Save your sorry explanations. Because they suck!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I never should have come! Guys are all the same!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They're all lying, dirty scumbags, and Sara, you're `welcome` to have this one!
nodes.text_bbcode: They're all lying, dirty scumbags, and Sara, you're [color=#3b78e2][i]welcome[/i][/color] to have this one!

nodes.text: Sam storms out.
Well... We can safely say it was probably a bad idea to restage the events of Nick and Sara's last near-kiss...
Try again and see if you can help Nick do a better job at showing Sam that `nothing happened!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Try again and see if you can help Nick do a better job at showing Sam that [b]nothing happened![/b]

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: At Sam's house...
Nick rings the doorbell nervously. $ZOE opens the front door.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She wants me to tell you that she never wants to talk to you ever again.
$ZOE lowers her voice down to a whisper.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But if you rush past me, swearing that you have to speak to her right now, I'll corroborate your story.
Nick flashes her a grateful smile.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Out of my way, $ZOE! I have to speak with your cousin right away!
Nick passes her and runs up to Sam's room.
Sam is sitting on her bed, her face in her pillow.
Nick knocks on the door.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is that loser worm-face gone yet?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Not quite.
Sam's head jerks up, and for a moment, Nick shrinks back at the fury of her gaze.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, I came to talk, to tell you the truth.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've heard `the truth` from `everyone else!` Now get out of my room!
nodes.text_bbcode: I've heard [color=#3b78e2][i]the truth[/i][/color] from [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone else![/i][/color] Now get out of my room!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, you haven't heard the truth `from me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you haven't heard the truth [color=#e23b3b][i]from me.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: At least hear me out.
Sam just glares at him. Nick takes her silence as acceptance.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, you're one of the most awesome people I know, and I care a lot about you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can't stand to see you upset when you have nothing to be upset over.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The photo's misleading. Jessica just put it up on the site to throw Sara out of the election and to hurt you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sara had nothing to do with it, and neither of us did anything wrong.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It might sound far-fetched, but it's the truth.
Sam sighs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...I believe you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Unlike my last boyfriend, you're the kind of guy who actually means what he says.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you've got to understand that it's not just about whether or not you did something wrong...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's about whether you `would.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's about whether you [color=#3b78e2][i]would.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't quite follow.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Today has made me think a lot about you and Sara. Would something `ever` happen between you two?
nodes.text_bbcode: Today has made me think a lot about you and Sara. Would something [color=#3b78e2][i]ever[/i][/color] happen between you two?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you can honestly tell me 'no', then I'll move past this. `We'll` move on.
nodes.text_bbcode: If you can honestly tell me 'no', then I'll move past this. [color=#3b78e2][i]We'll[/i][/color] move on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So tell me... Do you have any feelings at all for Sara?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, this is ridiculous.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Do` you?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Do[/i][/color] you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And it's probably going to get worse and worse until you can't stand it...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: People tend to talk ad nauseam about these things... That's why gossip blogs are so popular...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And of course, the people who think you betrayed Sam will consider you a social pariah...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Is this a pep talk? Because honestly, my `dad` gives better speeches, and he's always saying I'm dragging the team down.
nodes.text_bbcode: Is this a pep talk? Because honestly, my [color=#3b78e2][i]dad[/i][/color] gives better speeches, and he's always saying I'm dragging the team down.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm just trying to prepare you for the worst...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You're just making me more depressed!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, not to worry! You'll eventually hit rock bottom, and there'll be nowhere else to go!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh, yay.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That was a train wreck, wasn't it?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I get it, Nick. You're trying to help, so thank you.
His arms wrap around her, and for a second, she doesn't react.
Then she sinks into his embrace.
After a long moment, Nick pulls away.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks... I needed that...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Forget the campaign. How are you holding up other than that?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I've just had the worst day... It's been awful...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Everyone stares at me when I walk into a room...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: My swimming performance is lacking, and that always sets my dad off...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: The entire swim team is angry with me...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Not to mention Sam... She's on a whole other level of angry! She punched that little robot that cleans the pool in the face!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I wanted to tell her it was nothing, but she wouldn't even `look` at me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I wanted to tell her it was nothing, but she wouldn't even [color=#3b78e2][i]look[/i][/color] at me.

nodes.text: Nick steps forward to hug her.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: For me? Why?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I've gotten yelled at, I've gotten stuff thrown at me...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can only imagine what it must be like for you.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks for looking out for me, Nick...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You know you can talk to me.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's been... It's been hard...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: First off, I think the campaign's ruined... I'm pretty sure my name isn't the one they're going to announce tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And after all that hard work...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but I'm not really in the mood.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It sounds like we're not going to win anyway. I don't think `lying homewrecker` is really what people look for in a President.
nodes.text_bbcode: It sounds like we're not going to win anyway. I don't think [color=#3b78e2][i]lying homewrecker[/i][/color] is really what people look for in a President.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Now, if you'll excuse me... I should hit the showers...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, wait up... I'm not here about the campaign.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You're not?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Er...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: For your campaign?
Spencer drags Nick to the nearest dumpster and heaves him up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey... You don't need to do this...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Give me one good reason why I shouldn't dump your sorry butt into this trash heap!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I swear to you...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't kiss Sara!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The girl I `didn't` cheat on Sam with.
nodes.text_bbcode: The girl I [color=#e23b3b][i]didn't[/i][/color] cheat on Sam with.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But you still made Samface cry.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, `I` didn't do that directly! The website did! She just doesn't know the truth!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] didn't do that directly! The website did! She just doesn't know the truth!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Just let me talk to her... If she's still mad after that, then I'll throw myself in this dumpster.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Go make things right.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks... I'm so `glad...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks... I'm so [color=#e23b3b][i]glad...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Run before I change my mind!
Nick runs!
Once he feels safe, he comes to a stop, panting hard and trying to regain his breath.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Geez, in half a day, I've gotten yelled at twice and nearly thrown into the dumpster!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't hurt Sam!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Is that right?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Because I saw Samface earlier... And she looked pretty `hurt!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Because I saw Samface earlier... And she looked pretty [color=#e23b3b][i]hurt![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, yes, but...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So you're telling me that I shouldn't believe something I've seen with my own eyes?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're just like my dad when I saw that Bigfoot!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And you're supposed to be the smart one.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If you were really smart, you wouldn't have cheated on the most awesome girl in the world!
Spencer throws Nick into the dumpster!
Nick shuts his eyes as he lands in a pile of thrown-out, half-moldy food.
He tries to stand up, and his foot squishes down into a brown puddle that smells of spoiled milk.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ew... `Gross...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ew... [color=#e23b3b][i]Gross...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Stay down there!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And be warned, Brown. If I find out you've hurt Samface again, you'll regret it! Next time, what I do will be ten times worse!
Spencer slams the dumpster lid down. Nick waits for a moment then climbs out.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Geez, the day's barely started, and I've gotten yelled at twice and thrown into the dumpster!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And over a rumor about me and Sara that's not even true!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sara...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If `I'm` dealing with all of this, she must be getting it a hundred times worse!
nodes.text_bbcode: If [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] dealing with all of this, she must be getting it a hundred times worse!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe I should go check on her...
A few minutes later, in the swimming center...
Nick walks in just as swim practice is ending.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's it for today! Break!
The swim team heads towards the locker room. Sam is the first to leave.
She angrily bursts through the exit, followed by Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Come on, Sam... You can't be mad at `everyone...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, Sam... You can't be mad at [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick sees Sara trail behind with Jane, Cameron, and Linda.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You know, what you did to Sam was really terrible.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I agree. It was low, Sara. Girls deal with enough stupid crap from boys without turning on each other.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Anyone who backstabs their teammates... Well, that makes you the worst kind of girl.
Jane and Linda plunge into the locker room.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, you know, for what it's worth, I don't think you did anything terrible. It wasn't like `you` were in a relationship.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, you know, for what it's worth, I don't think you did anything terrible. It wasn't like [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] were in a relationship.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Cameron...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Come on, ease up. I'm just proud that you `kissed` someone... Really, Machine, I didn't think you had it in you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, ease up. I'm just proud that you [color=#e23b3b][i]kissed[/i][/color] someone... Really, Machine, I didn't think you had it in you.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Not `helping,` Cameron!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not [color=#3b78e2][i]helping,[/i][/color] Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Alright, alright... I'm out of here. But, you know, if you need to talk... I'll be around.
Cameron heads towards the boys' locker room. When he leaves, Sara slumps her shoulders and sinks down onto a bleacher.
Cautiously, Nick approaches her.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Nick, what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm here...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Aaaaaaieeee!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aaaaaaieeee![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wow, I've heard little kids scream better than you...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's... Really creepy...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And Samface really dated you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Take this like a man!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If you're going to hit me, do it quick!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Props for being manly about it...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But are you seriously kidding me? I'm not going to hit you...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh good...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm going to do something way worse!
Unsure what to do, Nick falls limp in Spencer's grip.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa, loser, did you just `faint?!`

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You think you're pretty quick on your feet, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, too bad! It's not going to help you now!
Spencer grabs Nick's shirt again, and Nick can tell this is going nowhere good.
With no other options, Nick acts quickly...
Nick starts kicking his feet and moving his arms.
The flailing causes Spencer to let go of him!
When he hits the ground, Nick runs a couple feet, desperate to get away...
But it doesn't take long for Spencer to catch up to him. He pushes Nick against the side of a mobile classroom.
Intimidated by Spencer, Nick freezes in fear!
Spencer throws him against the side of a mobile classroom.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oomph!
Nick tries to scramble away, but Spencer lunges forward and pushes him against the wall!
Spencer lifts Nick up higher...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I knew it!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hang on, I know it's confusing, but...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: When I said 'yes', I meant the exact opposite!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Stop with your `words.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Stop with your [color=#e23b3b][i]words.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, nope, no way!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't! I swear! I never cheated on a Sam or a Samwich or a Samface!
Spencer stops to evaluate what Nick's said...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Some people will say anything to get out of a beating.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well... Yes!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Er... Yes?
Outside in the parking lot, Nick turns from the classroom and runs straight into Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry, man, I...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `You.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're `Nick. Frikkin'. Brown.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're [color=#e23b3b][i]Nick. Frikkin'. Brown.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, that seems to be everyone's middle name today... I... `Hyk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that seems to be everyone's middle name today... I... [color=#e23b3b][i]Hyk![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer grabs a fistful of Nick's shirt and lifts him up.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whoa!
Spencer glares at Nick.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're the creep that cheated on Samface, is that right?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Is that right?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Is that right?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A long silence follows after...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: She looks so distraught... What should I say?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Look, Sara, I know it seems bad right now...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But enough about me... What are we going to do about you and Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: She must be furious with you...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Nick... I should have never asked you to be my campaign manager.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm not. It was worth it...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But it totally ruined your relationship with Sam...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sara, that wasn't your fault. And it's not ruined... I can fix it. I think.
At Sam's house...
Nick rings the doorbell nervously. $ZOE opens the front door.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She wants me to tell you that she never wants to talk to you ever again.
$ZOE lowers her voice down to a whisper.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But if you rush past me, swearing that you have to speak to her right now, I'll corroborate your story.
Nick flashes her a grateful smile.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Out of my way, $ZOE! I have to speak with your cousin right away!
Nick passes her and runs up to Sam's room.
Sam is sitting on her bed, her face in her pillow.
Nick knocks on the door.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is that loser worm-face gone yet?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Not quite.
Sam's head jerks up, and for a moment, Nick shrinks back at the fury of her gaze.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, I came to talk, to tell you the truth.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've heard `the truth` from `everyone else!` Now get out of my room!
nodes.text_bbcode: I've heard [color=#3b78e2][i]the truth[/i][/color] from [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone else![/i][/color] Now get out of my room!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, you haven't heard the truth `from me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you haven't heard the truth [color=#e23b3b][i]from me.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: At least hear me out.
Sam just glares at him. Nick takes her silence as acceptance.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, you're one of the most awesome people I know, and I care a lot about you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can't stand to see you upset when you have nothing to be upset over.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The photo's misleading. Jessica just put it up on the site to throw Sara out of the election and to hurt you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sara had nothing to do with it, and neither of us did anything wrong.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It might sound far-fetched, but it's the truth.
Sam sighs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...I believe you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Unlike my last boyfriend, you're the kind of guy who actually means what he says.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you've got to understand that it's not just about whether or not you did something wrong...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's about whether you `would.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's about whether you [color=#3b78e2][i]would.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't quite follow.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Today has made me think a lot about you and Sara. Would something `ever` happen between you two?
nodes.text_bbcode: Today has made me think a lot about you and Sara. Would something [color=#3b78e2][i]ever[/i][/color] happen between you two?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you can honestly tell me 'no', then I'll move past this. `We'll` move on.
nodes.text_bbcode: If you can honestly tell me 'no', then I'll move past this. [color=#3b78e2][i]We'll[/i][/color] move on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So tell me... Do you have any feelings at all for Sara?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, this is ridiculous.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Do` you?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Do[/i][/color] you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But it doesn't mean anything!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It does to me! I don't want to spend our entire relationship wondering if you're going to leave me for Sara!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Even if Sara and I get along, it doesn't mean I'm just going to ditch you. Who you want to be with is a choice!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And you're mine.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Nick. I can't do it. I can't be with you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe it's a selfish and impossible dream...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But for just `once,` I'd like to be the `only` choice.
nodes.text_bbcode: But for just [color=#3b78e2][i]once,[/i][/color] I'd like to be the [color=#3b78e2][i]only[/i][/color] choice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're `over.`
nodes.text_bbcode: We're [color=#3b78e2][i]over.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam... You... You can't mean that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You should go now.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Get. Out.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Get. Out.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick walks out of the room.
The next day in school...
Nick looks bleakly down at his desk as the morning announcements play on TV.
Erik appears onscreen next to a dour Justin.
On cue, Erik starts singing a jaunty tune.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Morning announcements with Justin and Erik... {

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Your news has never been more generic... {

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Tune in to hear all the fun good stuff... As we regale you with weather, traffic, elections, and fluff! {

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Stop with the `inane` singing...
nodes.text_bbcode: Stop with the [color=#e23b3b][i]inane[/i][/color] singing...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, someone woke up on the mopey side of the bed today! And I bet I know why!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Twin Branches, your votes have been cast, and your voice has been heard!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Your President for the new school year is...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Ben Kale!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ben Kale![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Erik claps his hands, while Justin rolls his eyes.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yes, congratulations to our new `President.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, congratulations to our new [color=#e23b3b][i]President.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hopefully, Ben's tenure will bring a golden period devoid of budget deficit, petty prank wars, and overly indulgent partying.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ditto, Justin! Hear hear! Long live `President Kale!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ditto, Justin! Hear hear! Long live [color=#e23b3b][i]President Kale![/i][/color]

nodes.text: In the classroom...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw man... I lost to Tweed?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Did no one like my bunny campaign?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So much for stopping Jessica...
Meanwhile, Ben cheers!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah! I did it! I won!
Around him, everyone starts clapping. Reluctantly, Nick joins in.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Long live `President Kale!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Long live [color=#3b78e2][i]President Kale![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica stands at Ben's side and shoots everyone a wide smile. When her gaze lands on Nick, she smiles even wider.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Next year, `things are going to change.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Next year, [color=#3b78e2][i]things are going to change.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Well, it sucks for Nick that Ben has won the election... And it's a bummer that Sam decided to break up with Nick...
But somehow, someway, this is the good ending! Be glad that you at least got Nick to talk to Sam!
But what will happen when Ben ascends to the Presidency? Will Jessica ever have to answer for all the terrible things that she's done?
Check in next week to see!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: Outside in the parking lot, Nick turns from the classroom and runs straight into Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry, man, I...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `You.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're `Nick. Frikkin'. Brown.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're [color=#e23b3b][i]Nick. Frikkin'. Brown.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, that seems to be everyone's middle name today... I... `Hyk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that seems to be everyone's middle name today... I... [color=#e23b3b][i]Hyk![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer grabs a fistful of Nick's shirt and lifts him up.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whoa!
Spencer glares at Nick.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're the creep that cheated on Samface, is that right?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Is that right?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Is that right?![/i][/color]

args.text: Before we tally your score, remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool to tell us what you thought of this episode and discuss SHS with other fans!
Achieving a grade of A or higher will unlock a special bonus scene!
You have unlocked the bonus scene! Enjoy!
At lunch after the Presidential announcement is made...
Nick finds Sara in the makeshift cafeteria, her lunch spread around her.
Mind if I sit?
No, go ahead.
So... About the campaign... Sorry about the loss.
Me too.
At least we had some fun.
Yeah, it was good while it lasted.
But you know what? There's always next year.
Would you consider running again?
You know...
I would...
I mean, we'd have to run a different campaign... But you'd be more experienced, so it'd be much easier.
Nick...
And now we have all year to plan for it. If we start early, I can introduce you to more constituents...
Nick...
And then think about all the time we have to modify your speeches...
`Nick.`
Nick trails off. Sara puts a hand on his arm.
I thought we said we weren't going to hang out after this election.
Oh, yeah... About that...
Did Sam change her mind?
Sam, uh, broke up with me.
Sara draws her hand back in surprise.
What? Even after you explained everything? If you need me to talk to her...
No, it's not that. She believed me when I said the photos were just posted to hurt your campaign.
Then why would you break up?
Well, she only wanted to be with me if I could tell her there was no one else, and...
And?
There is. It's you.
Nick watches Sara's face for a reaction, but she looks down.
Well, I'm sorry to hear about you and Sam. I mean, you were a really good couple.
You don't want to say any more about the fact that I just confessed I like you?
Nick... I feel the same way.
You do?
But what do you think is going to happen right now? You just broke up with Sam...
And with my dad being so strict... He'd never let me date anyone...
It doesn't seem like the right time to do anything about it.
Oh, I see...
False starts don't help you win marathons, is all I'm saying.
No, I get it. I do. I've just... I've had a bad day, you know.
Well, I'm going to leave you alone...
Nick, we're still friends, right?
Yeah, of course. We're still friends.
Sara puts a hand on his shoulder.
And, you know... Maybe someday after this blows over...
But suddenly, the loud slam of a door cuts off whatever Sara was going to say.
Sara instinctively draws her hand back, just as her dad enters the cafeteria.
Sara, what are you doing? You're late for your noontime training session!
Sorry, Dad, I must have forgot... Let me just get my things!
Sara gives Nick an apologetic look and runs out.
Coach Kessler gives Nick one long hard look then exits after her.
Well, it looks like a hard day just got harder for Nick!
But hopefully things will turn out better in the end!
And that's your bonus scene! See you next time on Surviving High school!

nodes.title: Ballot Breakup
nodes.subtitle: Can you help Nick talk to Sam?

nodes.text: At lunchtime on voting day, Nick walks up to Sam and $ZOE who are talking over takeout cups of hot chocolate.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, Sam... How's it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam hurls her hot chocolate at Nick's face!
But as soon as he comes close, Sara's nose crinkles.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What `is` that smell?
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] that smell?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's, uh... It's probably milk...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sticky... Weird... Brown milk... I really hope it was milk...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry, I... I've also had a rough morning.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm just going to stand over here.
Nick takes a step backwards.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Speaking of which... Enough time's probably passed. I should go talk to her.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Good luck!
